# A23 ordinary CLI rename continuation

Synthetic fixture only. Real local Git, pinned native Serena, product CLI, business checks and evidence gates; deterministic simulated implementation and independent review. No real model, GitHub/network, user-machine operation or deferred Controller/security test.

The fixture runs a task to verified using its original Markdown path. A separate fixture-operator commit renames only that input file on the target branch. CLI tasks reloads the same stable ID, content fingerprint, acceptance IDs and report mapping at the new path. Attempted delivery using old evidence is rejected with the task-change reason and leaves the target unchanged. The operator approves the revised task contract; explicit validate creates a fresh candidate on the advanced target without re-running implementation. H remains fixed, T/C change, checks and independent simulated review run anew. Authorized simulation delivery and closeout reach completed under the same task ID; new path/reports persist and no remote exists.

This is continuation of an already committed source, not dirty implementation recovery. No runtime code changed. The first fixture draft read independent from the wrong JSON object; this was corrected to result.json.review without changing product behavior. The final explicit two-test selection passed 2/2, zero skips, 35.831 seconds. See a23-task-rename-cli.log, a23-task-rename-summary.json and a23-task-rename-inputs.json. These files contain only synthetic data, not private Mac evidence. The existing global acceptance report was not updated.
